name: deterministic-gates
description: Deterministic backpressure for coding agents: gates that run on what each turn changed and send the agent back until they pass.

interface.shortDescription: Runs the gates of the repo on what each turn changed, and sends the agent back until they pass.
interface.longDescription: Deterministic backpressure for coding agents. At the end of each turn, the gates of the repo run on the files the turn changed: a linter, a type checker, the related tests, a dead-code finder. A gate is a tool, never a model. If a gate fails, the agent is sent back once with the report. The gates live in .gates.json; the catalog of the plugin lists the ones worth copying.
